facts.claim: Hawaii State Department of Health, 'Hawaii Birth & Marriage Certificates': certified copies of marriage certificates can be ordered online at vitrec.ehawaii.gov (recommended as fast), by mail or in person; a government-issued ID is needed and a fee applies. (Read live by the orchestrator, top-up 16 November 2026.)
Hawaii State Department of Health: 'Apostille or authentication requests are mail-in only.' (Read live by the orchestrator, top-up 16 November 2026.)

Hawaii State Department of Health: a certified copy is issued only to an applicant with a direct and tangible interest in the record; this includes the registrant and the registrant's spouse. (Read live by the orchestrator, top-up 16 November 2026.)
Hawaii State Department of Health: processing 'usually take[s] up to 4-6 weeks for orders', and delays may occur. (Read live by the orchestrator, top-up 16 November 2026.)

Hawaii DLNR Land Division, 'Commercial Activities': a right-of-entry permit through Wiki Permits is the process for a beach wedding or other commercial activity on unencumbered State shorelines; the permitted beach sites are listed by DLNR. (Read live by the orchestrator, top-up 16 November 2026.)

Hawaii DLNR Land Division: the shoreline is generally under State jurisdiction even where there is a county park, so an event on the sandy beach needs a permit from Wiki Permits; a few beaches are managed by other agencies such as the counties, and applicants should seek authorisation from that agency. (Read live by the orchestrator, top-up 16 November 2026.)

Hawaii DLNR Land Division: the applicant must submit a Certificate of Liability Insurance with the application, and the activity must comply with the General Terms and Conditions for Commercial Activity. (Read live by the orchestrator, top-up 16 November 2026.)

Hawaii State Department of Health, 'Marriage and Civil Union Licenses': a marriage licence and a marriage certificate are different documents; the licence permits the marriage to take place and the certificate shows a legal marriage has been performed. (Read live by the orchestrator, top-up 16 November 2026.)

Hawaii State Department of Health: the main licence office is on Oahu (Honolulu), open Monday to Friday excluding Hawaii State holidays, with appointments bookable online or by email; neighbour-island agents (Hawaii Island, Kauai, Maui, Molokai) are reached by phone, and private agents are also listed. (Read live by the orchestrator, top-up 16 November 2026.)
